cohort: The study included 96 pregnant women diagnosed with post-partum hemorrhage after caesarean section, admitted to Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University (BSMMU), Dhaka, Bangladesh.
finding: The study found that blood transfusion, anaemia, vomiting, and infection rates were less frequent in the carbetocin group (Group I) compared to the oxytocin group (Group II) for the management of postpartum hemorrhage after caesarean section.
